faqs.question: Is the Equitas Selfe Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: No. The card has a joining fee and an annual fee of ₹1,000 + GST. However, the annual fee is waived if you spend at least ₹2.4 lakh with the card in the previous year.

faqs.question: What is the maximum reward rate on the Equitas Selfe Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The card offers an effective reward rate of up to 10% on your chosen spending categories once you unlock the top Diamond Tier.

faqs.question: How do 5X rewards work on the Equitas Selfe Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You can pick any two categories from grocery, dining, utilities, taxis, and apparel. Spending on these chosen categories will earn you 10 reward points for every ₹100 spent.

faqs.question: Which categories can I choose for 5X rewards?
faqs.answer: You can select any two options from the following list: Grocery, Dining, Utility, Taxi, and Apparel.

faqs.question: Can I change my reward categories later?
faqs.answer: Yes. If your monthly expenses change, you can easily switch and update your selected categories through the Equitas Mobile Banking App.

faqs.question: Does the Equitas Selfe Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get 1 complimentary domestic airport lounge visit per calendar quarter, as long as you meet the card's minimum spend criteria in the previous quarter.

faqs.question: Does the Equitas Selfe Credit Card offer international lounge access?
faqs.answer: No. The card does not offer complimentary access to international airport lounges.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on the Equitas Selfe Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The forex fee drops as you hit higher tiers. It starts at 3.5% for Blue Tier cardholders and reduces step-by-step until it hits 0% at the top Diamond Tier.

faqs.question: What is Diamond Tier on the Equitas Selfe Credit Card?
faqs.answer: Diamond Tier is the highest level you can achieve on the card. It unlocks the premium 10% reward rate, a 0% forex markup, quarterly gift vouchers, golf benefits, and annual flight and hotel vouchers.

faqs.question: Is the Equitas Selfe Credit Card worth it?
faqs.answer: This card is an excellent choice if you can consistently spend ₹40,000 or more each month. Reaching the higher tiers unlocks premium rewards and benefits that go far beyond your average entry-level credit card.
